posts.title: 9 Games That Shaped Me, In Some Way
posts.description: A thing has been going around on Mastodon (and probably other social media) where people make this grid of games that shaped them. This kind of thing isn’t super interesting or revealing to me unless I understand something of why or how the “shaping” happened, so here’s a post with my 9 games and a little explanation of each one. posts.title: Weather
posts.description: Weather Your thoughts are just weather that happens to you. And you’re just whatever they’re happening to. It may seem to you that the storm wants you dead, but the storm wanting anything’s all in your head. The wind doesn’t blow just to knock down the tree, the rain doesn’t long to return to the sea, the waves don’t intend to bring vessels to rest; the driftwood lays smooth on the beach nonethele
